labels: Y = course teaches the matched task; P = task only peripheral (audience, job roles, a passing mention); N = wrong match

fresh_sample_after_fixes.design: 52 matched courses drawn at random (seed 589), excluding the development sample

development_sample_before_fixes.design: 6 per task (4 outcomes, 2 description), seed 588; used to find and fix false-positive patterns, so its after-fix figures are optimistic and not reported

industry_tags_before_fixes.fixed: Admin and office no longer matches bare 'administration' (4 of 5 were wrong); Talent Casting no longer HR; radiology now Healthcare

caveats: Labels are an AI reviewer's judgement; a human should confirm human_label before reporting
Small samples: a 52-item precision of 67% has a 95% interval of roughly 54-79%
Precision only: missed tasks (recall) were not measured
